## 🐛 Bug Maturity Level

- [ ] 🆕 `bug:new` — newly reported
- [ ] 🔍 `bug:triage` — under review
- [ ] 📋 `bug:confirmed` — valid bug
- [ ] ⚙️ `bug:in-progress` — being fixed
- [ ] 🧪 `bug:qa` — awaiting verification
- [ ] ✅ `bug:done` — fixed & verified
